Sasha (PM): quick heads-up — Sales just handed a large enterprise ask that would add SSO + per-route audit logs + 99.99 SLA. They want rollout in 8 weeks. Can we realistically slot this into Q2 or do we push to Q3?
Kevin (Eng): eight weeks for those three items is tight. SSO + audit logs is mostly infra + auth work, SLA is more perf + infra. Need capacity and testing window.
Tom (Sales): customer is clear: must have per-route audit for compliance, and SLA is non-negotiable. They sign if we can commit to the timeline.
Anna (Design): from UX side SSO is small (we have patterns). Audit log UI might take 2 sprints if we do a polished UI, could ship with a simple CSV export first.
Maria (PMM): revenue delta is high — this is our first in-region regulated customer. Impact could be 5–7x ACV compared to typical deals.
Sasha (PM): thinking about prioritization: do we treat this as a single big ticket or break into must-have vs nice-to-have? Suggest RICE quick pass to compare with existing Q2 bets.
dev-bot: reminder — please add items to the shared RICE sheet: https://docs.redwood/repo/priority-sheet
Kevin (Eng): quick dev estimates: SSO ~ 2 devs x 3w, audit logs backend ~ 3 devs x 4w, UI ~ 1.5 devs x 4w, SLA infra ops ~ 2 devs x 3w for reliability testing + obs. Parallelizing helps but still ~8–10 dev-weeks total with testing.
Sasha (PM): let's do a small RICE sketch in thread: Reach = large enterprise = 1 customer but strategic (assign 0.2 relative weight), Impact = high for revenue + reference = 8/10, Confidence = 60%, Effort = 10 dev-weeks. Anyone object to those numbers?
Maria (PMM): I think Impact should be 9 given partner halo. Confidence maybe 50 because of infra unknowns.
Kevin (Eng): lower Confidence to 40 if we assume SLA tuning surprises. Effort may be underestimated if we include on-call runbook and chaos testing.
Anna (Design): if we accept shipping CSV-first for audit logs, UI effort drops by ~60%. That's a sequencing lever: backend + CSV -> sales demo, polished UI later.
Tom (Sales): CSV-first is fine for contract signing. We need audit log semantics documented and available in the product within the contract date.
Sasha (PM): OK proposal: 1) scope cut: ship SSO + backend audit CSV + contractual SLA guardrails (not 99.99 initially, but commit to roadmap for SLA improvements) 2) parallel track: reliability work and UI in Q3. That would reduce Effort to ~6 dev-weeks for Q2.
Kevin (Eng): that puts RICE-ish numbers in better shape. But we should add a sequencing risk: if we promise SLA improvement later, legal might push for liability clauses. Need sales + legal to align.
Tom (Sales): legal already flagged that. We can hedge with timeboxed SLA targets and credits. I'll coordinate.
Maria (PMM): product marketing asks for clear launch criteria: must-have = SSO working end-to-end, audit export present, SLA documented in contract. Nice-to-have = real-time log streaming + UI.
Sasha (PM): vote check: do we pull highest-priority infra slot (predictive cache refactor) out of Q2 to make room? That was scored Impact 6, Effort 5. This enterprise ask would be Impact 9 if it lands.
Kevin (Eng): I'm cautious about de-prioritizing cache refactor — it's a cost-saver and affects many customers. But we can trim scope of that refactor and focus on low-risk parts.
Anna (Design): if we compress design work and accept CSV-first, design impact on other work is minimal.
Sasha (PM): next steps: 1) Tom to confirm legal acceptance of timeboxed SLA language by EOD Friday 2) Kevin to update dev estimate + risks 3) Sasha + Maria to update RICE sheet with revised numbers and sequencing plan 4) quick sync Monday with eng lead to lock commits.
Tom (Sales): on it — pinging legal now. @legal-team FYI. :eyes:
Kevin (Eng): will post updated estimate + risk bullets in the doc by tomorrow.
Maria (PMM): I'll update launch criteria and messaging draft once we have the EOD legal note.
Sasha (PM): thanks all. If legal greenlights timeboxed SLA we push this as Candidate A for Q2 and present at Tuesday prioritization sync. If not, defer to Q3. :+1:
Tom (Sales): fingers crossed.
dev-bot: deploy reminder — prioritization sync Tue 10am calendar invite sent. :calendar:
